content.comment_body: I want to create an off-delay timer using [product_name]. The system should allow two buttons to start the timer; pressing button 1 adds one minute, and pressing button 2 adds fifteen minutes. For example, pressing button 1 three times should add three minutes. The timer will control a single output. I'm unsure how to configure this in programming.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are collaborating to create a custom off-delay timer using [product_name] hardware, enabling incremental time additions via two buttons. Some users faced hardware constraints, such as the inability to use certain logic blocks with older CPU versions, and resolved this by switching to newer models.
